demos.name: AI Guard Sidecar
demos.description: How an external guardrail sidecar plugs into an agent gateway: a stand-in detector, per-category block thresholds, PII rails, a fail-closed toggle and a fault injector. Contract unverified; offline.
demos.notes: Host-run: npm install && npm run build && npm start (port 6500; npm run doctor checks it). Or: docker compose up --build -d (publishes 127.0.0.1:6500 only; the standalone sidecar on 6501 is host-run only and not in the image; HOST_PORT changes the published port, and the shelf's Start button does not set HOST_PORT). Edit composeFile to this checkout's absolute path.
